examples.title: Example 1: Adding a Selection Area to AtomicServiceSearch
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the select parameter to add a selection area on the left to the AtomicServiceSearch component.

examples.title: Example 2: Adding a Function Item to AtomicServiceSearch
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the operation parameter to add a function item on the right to the AtomicServiceSearch component.

examples.title: Example 3: Adding a Selection Area and Function Item to AtomicServiceSearch
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to add the selection area and function items on the left and right to the AtomicServiceSearch component.

examples.title: Example 4: Binding the Search Callback Events to AtomicServiceSearch
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to use the onWillInsert, onDidInsert, onWillDelete, and onDidDelete APIs to implement insert and delete operations.
The onSubmit API is used to submit content in the search area.
The onChange API is used to listen for the content changes in the search area.

examples.title: Example 5: Customizing the Style of AtomicServiceSearch
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the search, select, value, and placeholder parameters to customize the style of the AtomicServiceSearch component.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the Caret Position Using controller
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the controller parameter to set the caret position, select the content in the specified area, and disable the editing state.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Enter Key Type
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the enterKeyType attribute to dynamically change the effect of the Enter key on the soft keyboard.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting Text Feature Effects
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the fontFeature attribute to display text with various typographic features.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting Text Auto-Adaptation
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the minFontSize and maxFontSize attributes to implement the text auto-adaptation features.

examples.title: Example 10: Setting Custom Menu Extensions
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the editMenuOptions API to create custom menu extensions for text settings. It includes customizing text content, icons, and callbacks for these extensions.

examples.title: Example 11: Setting the Horizontal Alignment, Caret Style, and Background Color of the Selected Text
examples.description: This example shows how to set the horizontal alignment, caret style, and background color of the selected text using textAlign, caretStyle, and selectedBackgroundColor.

examples.title: Example 12: Setting Input Filtering
examples.description: This example shows how to set input filtering using inputFilter.
